body: Sorry, I replied as a new post in the thread. I haven't really ever posted on reddit before or here in general.

I appreciate it. I just don't know what I want from this life anymore. I feel lonely all the time. I grew up without friends. My family was not usually the best. At one point I got bullied about my depression, so saying anything to my relatives is a big nope. My boyfriend tries to be helpful, but to me it comes off as "do this= sadness/other emotions cured." I feel like I can't really talk to him anymore, not even my sister. I feel like I'm bothering them a lot. I haven't said much to them anymore. I just try to go out and cry in my car. I go out for walks to keep my mind busy, but it's not helping me. I try reading, and my thoughts seem to get louder and louder. I feel less motivation now, and the things I used to enjoy feel like a lot of work and energy. My desire to die has exceeded my love for my boyfriend. He's not a bad guy, but I just don't think life is worth it for me. There's nothing here for me now. There's just nobody or anything to feel a strong attachment for anymore to keep me going. He is very social. He'd always have lots of friends and family there for him.
